_comment: Data-table-driven inputs for the SCORCH PFC downstream Azimuth workflow (ScrnaDownstream in terra_wdl/downstream.wdl). Root entity for each submission = a sample_set row (same scorch_pfc_sample_set_table.tsv used by the main pipeline). One submission fans out across all selected sample_sets. IMPORTANT: pegasus_h5ad below binds to the sample_set attribute 'pegasus_hybrid_filtered_h5ad' -- this only resolves if the MAIN pipeline was configured to write its outputs back to the data table. If that column is NOT present on your sample_set table, run tests/harvest_pegasus_h5ad.ps1 to build scorch_pfc_pegasus_h5ad.tsv, import it to populate the column, THEN run this. batch_name MUST equal the main run's batch_name (this.sample_set_id) because it is the {batch}_Hybrid_filtered.h5ad filename prefix.
